Messages.Author: Robert Matthew Edens
Messages.Body:
Anyone help with this interpretation? When playing Millie does she play
infront of the Meth. bringing her out, or does she instead get played on
some other sap?
Rob

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:



Since she doesn't say "Play on a Methusealh", you must bring her out on
yourself. At the end of your turn, she moves to your Predator (card text).

Messages.Author: Romu Sebastian J B
Messages.Body:
Robert Matthew Edens (red...@gladstone.uoregon.edu) scribbles:
:Anyone help with this interpretation? When playing Millie does she play

:infront of the Meth. bringing her out, or does she instead get played on
:some other sap?
:Rob

She's yours if you play her... but only for the round... then she's your
predator's... sort of a 'you can't bleed me on your turn' card...

Two player game (or endgame)... play Millicent Smith, and the Anarch Trouble
maker... lots of fun. :)

Seb.
